configuration.input: 246 features = DC_z, one value per Brainnetome ROI (channel index 2 of X_regional.npy, verified)
configuration.architecture: MLP, 2 hidden layers of width 64, LayerNorm+GELU+dropout 0.3
configuration.head: multiclass 6-way softmax, argmax decode
configuration.optimiser: AdamW lr=1e-3 weight_decay=1e-2, batch 16, grad clip 1.0
configuration.epochs: max 120, early stopping patience 20 on validation balanced accuracy
configuration.class_weighting: inverse class frequency from the training fold
configuration.preprocessing: per-feature standardisation fitted on the training fold only

evidence.design: 25 paired fold evaluations, identical fold fingerprints, subject IDs and labels verified in all 25 pairs

model_freeze.rationale: The advantage is consistent in direction across all five split seeds and 18 of 25 folds, it holds on balanced accuracy, accuracy and macro-F1 simultaneously, no class is ever left unpredicted, the worst per-class recall improves (0.19 vs 0.13), and the model uses 3.3x fewer parameters on a single biomarker. MAE and QWK are effectively unchanged.
model_freeze.uncertainty: The effect is SMALL relative to fold noise: +0.0289 against a fold-level sd of 0.1065, a ratio of 0.27. Direction is consistent; magnitude is not established. Two of five seeds show a gain of only +0.006. This is a defensible simplification, not a demonstrated performance breakthrough.
model_freeze.caveat: DC_z being the most predictive single biomarker is NOT evidence that degree centrality is biologically privileged in Alzheimer's disease. Phase 6D found NO stable ROI importance (mean pairwise Spearman +0.012).
model_freeze.test_set_history: evaluated once on 2026-10-15 by the faulty argmax-decoder ordinal run. NOT pristine. No model selection has used it.
model_freeze.authorisation_required: held-out evaluation NOT run; awaiting explicit user authorisation

repeated_cv.design: 5 stratified subject-level folds x 5 split seeds = 25 evaluations per candidate, 125 total; one fold assignment per seed shared by all candidates so comparisons are paired; training-fold-only preprocessing
repeated_cv.quality_control: all 25 partitions contained all six classes; 500/500 metrics recomputed from saved predictions matched exactly
repeated_cv.statistical_note: the 125 evaluations are NOT independent -- within a seed the five folds partition the same 81 subjects, and all seeds reuse those subjects. Seed-level means are the primary summary; the reported +/- is sensitivity to partitioning, not a standard error. No p-values are reported.

feature_mapping_verified.layout: 984 = 246 ROIs x 4 channels, INTERLEAVED: index = roi*4 + channel
feature_mapping_verified.fc_caveat: channel 3 is NOT the connectivity matrix. It is a 246-D summary mean_{j!=i}|z_ij|; 30,135 unique edges are compressed to 246 values. Verified by recomputing it from X_fc.npy.
feature_mapping_verified.normalisation: within-acquisition (leakage-free) then per-feature standardisation fitted on the training fold only

phase6a_biomarker_ablation.design: 6 configurations x 5 seeds x 5 folds = 150 evaluations, paired folds
key_findings: DC alone (246 features) beat all four combined (984) on 5/5 seeds for balanced accuracy (0.307 vs 0.278). Combining biomarkers did NOT help.
FC as 30,135 edges (1.9M parameters) was no better than FC as a 246-D summary (0.292 vs 0.296), so the compression loses nothing measurable here.
mALFF was the weakest single biomarker (0.239), below the combined model on 4/5 seeds.
All differences are small relative to the fold-level spread (sd 0.08-0.11), so these are rankings, not established effects.
phase6a_biomarker_ablation.caveat: predictive usefulness is not biological importance

phase6d_roi_importance.method: permutation importance on validation subjects only, grouped by ROI (4 channels together) and by biomarker (246 ROIs together), 5 repeats, 25 fold-models
controls: label-shuffled null: whole procedure repeated with permuted training labels
phase6d_roi_importance.result: NO STABLE ROI IMPORTANCE COULD BE ESTABLISHED

evidence.rank_stability_note: essentially zero agreement between folds; range -0.223 to +0.225
evidence.real_vs_null: 7.0% of ROI-folds exceeded the 95th percentile of the label-shuffled null, against 5% expected by construction
evidence.biomarker_importance: all four channels near zero; positive drop in only 10-15 of 25 folds, i.e. a coin flip
evidence.top_roi_recurrence: the highest-ranked ROI appeared in the top 20 in only 4 of 25 folds

phase6d_roi_importance.methodological_caveat: models here were trained for a fixed 60 epochs with NO early stopping, to avoid selecting the checkpoint on the same validation subjects used for importance. They therefore reached only 0.176 mean validation balanced accuracy, below the frozen model's 0.278. Importance estimated from a weak model is correspondingly weak evidence.
phase6d_roi_importance.conclusion: ROI rankings from this cohort are not reproducible across partitions and must not be reported as disease-relevant regions.

model_freeze_history.reason_superseded: Phase 6A ablation showed dc_only beats all_four on 5/5 seeds with 3.3x fewer parameters

final_heldout_evaluation.status: COMPLETED -- run once under explicit user authorisation on 2026-10-15
final_heldout_evaluation.epoch_selection: mean best epoch over the 22 of 25 CV folds that beat chance, +1, floored at 10; test labels played no part
final_heldout_evaluation.limitation_checkpoint: no weights file existed for the frozen model; it was reproduced deterministically from the documented procedure and recorded seed

interpretation.headline: held-out balanced accuracy 0.200 against a 0.167 majority-class baseline on the same 35 subjects, and against a repeated-CV mean of 0.307
interpretation.shortfall: the held-out estimate is BELOW the cross-validated mean. With 35 subjects one subject moves balanced accuracy by ~0.029, so 0.200 vs 0.307 is roughly 3.7 subjects' worth of difference and is within what partition luck can produce. It should not be read as either refuting or confirming the CV estimate.
interpretation.positives: all six stages were predicted (no collapse); QWK +0.152 indicates errors tend toward neighbouring stages; CN recall 0.50 is the strongest class
interpretation.negatives: SMC recall 0.00 (none of its 6 subjects identified); EMCI, LMCI and AD recall all 0.167; MAE 1.83 stages

final_heldout_evaluation.test_set_history: this set was ALSO evaluated on 2026-10-15 by the faulty argmax-decoder ordinal run. It is NOT pristine. That earlier access did not inform any model selection, and the present evaluation is the first and only assessment of the frozen model.
final_heldout_evaluation.stop_condition: No further tuning or model selection will use these results.
